install: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; command -v bun >/dev/null || (curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash); export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; if [ ! -d "$HOME/gstack" ]; then git clone --single-branch --depth 1 https://github.com/garrytan/gstack.git "$HOME/gstack"; fi; cd "$HOME/gstack" && ./setup --host cursor; mkdir -p .cursor/skills; for d in "$HOME/gstack/.cursor/skills"/gstack*/; do ln -sfn "$d" ".cursor/skills/$(basename "$d")"; done; chmod -R a+rX "$HOME/.cursor/skills" 2>/dev/null || true; command -v sshpass >/dev/null || (sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq sshpass openssh-client)
